idea-plugin.name: Pair Flow
idea-plugin.description:
Build with AI one reviewed code chunk at a time.

Describe a goal, approve the plan, then review every proposed change in the IDE diff viewer before it touches your files. Nothing is written without your explicit approval.

  • Plan first: the AI maps the work into short chapters you approve up front.
  • Review each chunk: at most three files per chapter, shown as native diffs.
  • Bring your own model: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter or a local Ollama.
  • Sessions are saved, so you can pause, resume or retry at any point.
